lines: 大周王朝，吴州，东宁府。
东宁府城八大道院之一的‘镜湖道院’正门，一名腰间佩刀的少年从道院中走出。
“孟师兄。”
“孟师兄好。”
“见过孟师兄。”
周围的其他同门们都颇为热情。
少年孟川向这些师弟师妹们微微点头，其实这些‘师弟师妹们’很多都比他年龄更大，不过镜湖道院的规矩是达者为先，他早在两年前就已经进入镜湖道院‘山水楼’，山水楼二十二位弟子，也是镜湖道院最强的二十二位，受众多师弟师妹们仰慕向往。而其中‘孟师兄’尤为受推崇，是因为孟师兄偶尔会会指点他们，其他山水楼师兄师姐却懒得浪费时间在他人身上。
“公子，公子。”忽然一道熟悉的声音从旁边传来。
从一旁跑出来一名绿衣少女，孟川见状笑了：“绿竹，你怎么来了？”
“我家小姐想要请公子一起去东山游玩，昨夜刚刚一场大雪，雪后的东山可美得很。”绿衣少女笑道。
“去东山游玩？”孟川眉头一凝，说道，“东山太远了，去一趟怕是要在东山过夜了，等明日才能回来。”
绿衣少女笑道：“我云家在东山恰好有一处别院，可以在那过夜。”
孟川摇头道：“回去告诉青萍，就说一个多月后就是玉阳宫斩妖盛会，我需潜心修行以做准备，无法陪她过去。”
“这……”绿衣少女犹豫。
“你回去直接说就是了。”孟川吩咐道，“还有，让青萍多花点时间修行，别总是想着出去游玩。”
“是。”绿衣少女只能乖乖应着，回去禀报。
孟川微微摇头。
对于从小定下婚约的‘云青萍’他也有些头疼。
镜湖道院是建造在镜湖东岸，在镜湖西岸还有许多府宅，其中就有一座‘孟府’。
“少爷。”府门口有两名守卫，看到孟川便颇为恭敬。
“我爹在府里么？”孟川问道。
“刚刚祖宅那边派人来，老爷便立即赶去了。”守卫说道。
孟川若有所思点点头，便进入府中。
“咻咻咻！！！”很快便依稀听到箭矢的声音，孟川循声来到了练武场。
练武场正有一名红衣少女在弯弓射箭，一根根箭矢，瞬间穿过数十丈接连射在靶子上，且后一箭都射在前一箭箭杆上。
孟川在一旁看着对方练箭。
她叫柳七月，是自己父亲的生死兄弟‘柳夜白’的独女。
自己八岁那年……
柳夜白带着女儿来到了孟府，从此便住下。
七月和自己很像，都是很小就没了母亲。从小，七月就和自己一同修炼，一直修炼至今，感情极深。
“阿川，你回来了。”红衣少女看到孟川眼睛一亮，“射这些靶子真没意思，来来来，赶紧给我当靶子。如果不是为了等你，我早去道院练箭了，道院的弓箭场可比这大多了。”
“好，给你当靶子。”
孟川笑着走到练武场中央。
红衣少女换了一箭囊，箭矢也都是没有箭头的，她眼睛放光看着孟川：“阿川，你可得小心了，别又被我揍得鼻青脸肿。”
“你也小心，我这次定要破了你的七星连珠箭。”孟川凝神以待。
红衣少女嘻嘻一笑，跟着手指犹如幻影，瞬间拉弓射箭，似乎都不需要瞄准。
咻咻咻！！！一箭又一箭，接连射出。每一次从背后箭囊取箭拉弓射箭，再取箭拉弓射箭……就仿佛正常人呼吸一般自然，一根根箭矢也快得惊人，威力同样极大。
“噗噗噗。”孟川腰间的刀已经出鞘。
content_en:
Great Zhou Dynasty, Wuzhou, Dongning Prefecture.
At the main entrance of the 'Jinghu Taoist Temple', one of the eight Taoist temples in Dongning Fucheng, a young man with a sword on his waist walked out of the Taoist Temple.
"Senior Brother Meng."
"Hello, Senior Brother Meng."
"I've met Senior Brother Meng."
The other classmates around him were quite enthusiastic.
The young Meng Chuan nodded slightly to these junior brothers and sisters. In fact, many of these "junior brothers and sisters" are older than him, but the rule of Jinghu Taoist Temple is that those who achieve first come first. He had entered Jinghu Taoist Temple's "Landscape Building" two years ago. The twenty-two disciples of Shanshui Building are also the twenty-two strongest in Jinghu Taoist Temple, and they are admired and yearned by many junior brothers and sisters. Among them, 'Senior Brother Meng' is particularly respected because Senior Brother Meng will occasionally give them guidance, while other senior brothers and sisters from Shanshui Tower are too lazy to waste time on others.
"Master, Master." Suddenly a familiar voice came from the side.
A girl in green ran out from the side. Meng Chuan smiled when he saw this: "Luzhu, why are you here?"
"My young lady wants to invite the young master to go to Dongshan with us. There was a heavy snowfall last night. Dongshan is very beautiful after the snow." The girl in green said with a smile.
"Going to Dongshan?" Meng Chuan frowned and said, "Dongshan is too far. If you go there, you may have to spend the night in Dongshan and won't be able to come back until tomorrow."
The girl in green clothes smiled and said: "My Yun family happens to have a villa in Dongshan, where we can spend the night."
Meng Chuan shook his head and said: "Go back and tell Qingping that the Yuyang Palace Demon Slaying Festival will be held in more than a month. I need to concentrate on training to prepare, and I can't accompany her there."
"This..." The girl in green hesitated.
"Just tell her when you get back." Meng Chuan ordered, "Also, let Qingping spend more time practicing and don't always think about going out for fun."
"Yes." The girl in green could only respond obediently and go back to report.
Meng Chuan shook his head slightly.
He also has some headaches about 'Yun Qingping', who has been engaged since childhood.
…
Jinghu Taoist Temple was built on the east bank of Jinghu Lake. There are many mansions on the west bank of Jinghu Lake, among which is the Meng Mansion.
"Master." There were two guards at the door of the mansion, and they were quite respectful when they saw Meng Chuan.
"Is my father in the house?" Meng Chuan asked.
"Just now someone was sent from the ancestral home, and the master rushed there immediately," the guard said.
Meng Chuan nodded thoughtfully and entered the mansion.
"Boohoo!!!!" Soon the sound of arrows was vaguely heard, and Meng Chuan followed the sound to the martial arts training ground.
In the martial arts training ground, a girl in red was bending a bow and shooting arrows. Arrows shot through dozens of feet in an instant and hit the target one after another, with the next arrow hitting the shaft of the previous one.
Meng Chuan watched the opponent practice archery from the side.
Her name is Liu Qiyue, and she is the only daughter of her father’s life-and-death brother ‘Liu Yebai’.
When I was eight years old...
Liu Yebai brought his daughter to Meng Mansion and stayed there ever since.
Qi Qi is very similar to herself, both lost their mothers when they were very young. Since childhood, Qiyue has been practicing with him, and they have been practicing together to this day, and their relationship is very deep.
"Achuan, you're back." The girl in red's eyes lit up when she saw Meng Chuan. "It's so boring to shoot these targets. Come on, come on, make me a target. If it weren't for waiting for you, I would have gone to the Taoist Academy to practice archery. The Taoist archery range is much bigger than this."
"Okay, let me be your target."
Meng Chuan walked to the center of the martial arts training ground with a smile.
The girl in red changed her quiver, and the arrows also had no arrowheads. She looked at Meng Chuan with bright eyes: "Achuan, you have to be careful, don't get beaten up again by me."
"Be careful, I will definitely break your seven-star arrow this time." Meng Chuan waited intently.
The girl in red smiled, followed her fingers like a phantom, and instantly drew the bow and shot the arrow, seemingly without having to aim.
Whoosh! ! ! Arrow after arrow was shot out one after another. Every time he takes an arrow from the quiver on his back, draws the bow and shoots, and then takes an arrow, draws the bow and shoots... it's as natural as a normal person breathing, each arrow is also incredibly fast and equally powerful.
"Puff puff." The knife on Meng Chuan's waist has been unsheathed.
